2026 Enterprise AI Infra 4-Layer Reference Architecture & Sizing Blueprint
Uniting KV-Aware Gateway, P/D Disaggregation, 3-Watermark Sizing & Priority Backfill Cuts $/1M Tokens by 10x ($2.40 -> $0.24)
• L1 Edge: Envoy/APIM + GIE KV-Aware Router + Presidio PII Vault
• L1 Transport: Unbuffered HTTP/3 SSE + <10ms Client Abort Cancel
• L2 Serving: P/D Disaggregation (>=8K) + Mooncake/LMCache RDMA KV
• L2 Elasticity: CRIU+cuda-checkpoint (3.2s) + 65% KV Priority Backfill
• L3 Sizing: 3-Watermark GPU Sizer + NVLink TP=8 / RDMA DeepEP
• L3 Kernels: vLLM V1 ZMQ + Piecewise CUDA Graph + FP8 / EAGLE-3
• L4 Fabric: 400G/800G Rail-Optimized RoCEv2/IB + BlueField-3 DPU
• L4 Governance: OTel GenAI 4-Tuple FinOps + Kueue TAS + Async DCP
